desc:
LUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten or gelatin; Each serving has a good source of vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Enjoy delicious Gushers Fruit Flavored Snacks in Tropical flavor; These snacks are bursting with yummy liquid

FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

ON THE GO: Portable pouches are ideal for the pantry, school lunch box, team snacks, kids parties, and more

CONTAINS: One box of Gushers Tropical Fruit Flavored Snacks; 6 Ct, 4.8 oz
features:
Features

Juicy Liquid Center

Each piece features a chewy exterior with a fun, fruity liquid core that "gushes" as you bite into it.

Tropical Flavor Variety

Offers a bold and refreshing mix of tropical fruit-inspired flavors that kids and adults enjoy.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free

Safe for those with gluten sensitivity and suitable for vegetarian or vegan-friendly diets.

Good Source of Vitamin C

Each pouch contains around 10% of your recommended daily intake of Vitamin C.

Kosher Certified

Suitable for individuals following kosher dietary practices.

Individually Wrapped Pouches

Each 0.8 oz pouch is pre-portioned and easy to carry—ideal for snacking on-the-go.

Benefits

Fun, Interactive Snack Experience

The gush of liquid and chewy texture makes this snack exciting and satisfying for kids and nostalgic adults

Perfect for On-the-Go

Compact, single-serve pouches fit easily into lunchboxes, purses, or snack drawers.

Kid-Friendly & Crowd-Pleaser

Loved for its sweet taste and playful texture—great for birthday parties, lunch treats, or road trips

Supports Dietary Needs

Free from gluten, gelatin, and artificial flavors—suitable for many dietary preferences.

Small Boost of Nutrients

Fortified with Vitamin C for a light health benefit over traditional candy.
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Modified Corn Starch, Fructose, Maltodextrin, Palm Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Cottonseed Oil, Glycerin, Grape Juice Concentrate, Citric Acid, Carrageenan, Monoglycerides, Sodium Citrate, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural and Artificial Flavor, Potassium Citrate, Agar-Agar, Xanthan Gum, Color (red 40, blue 1, yellows 5 & 6).
